description: Lists coins on Souvenir, searched and sorted. Answers { coins, nextCursor }. Each coin: mint, symbol, name, image, venue (pump, meteora or bags), origin (launched on Souvenir or brought), mode (full: its rounds draw an item; draws: they pay drawSol in SOL; prizes: its creator awards prizes; redeem: no draws; holders burn coins for its one prize), potSol (the open pot), prize (full and redeem modes: id, image, priceUsd), round (the latest unfinished one: number, state, targetSol, potSol), holders (at the latest snapshot), links and pair ({ symbol, mint, solPerSouv } on a coin that trades against $SOUVENIR, else null). For the next page, pass nextCursor back as cursor; it is null on the last page. Coins whose prize is adult (NSFW) are left out, as on the site, unless nsfw is true.

nsfw.description: true to list coins whose prize is adult (NSFW) too; left out by default.

q.description: Search: a coin's name or ticker ($ optional), its prize's name, or the start of its mint.

sort.description: pot: the largest open pot first. new: the newest launch first. drawing: the closest to its next draw first (the pot nearest its target). holders: the most holders first.

venue.description: Only coins trading there: pump.fun, Meteora or Bags.
